entries.text: Welcome, traveler. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Bring 123 gold pieces, and we can begin.
Very well. Watch the narrow letters: minimum, little, willing. Look at the rounded letters: courage, moon, doorway.

replies.text: Tell me more about this place and the people who live here.
<StartAction>Examine the map.</Start> What lies beyond the northern gate?
Goodbye. I will return another day.
